title: It fits but....
text: It fits but..... I have the 6-qt lift model and was excited about this alternative for small batches. Although this unit fits and works, the wire whip that comes with is strictly for things like whip cream, egg whites, and other SOFT/liquid type things. I attempted to use it for cookie icing and the whip seemed very fragile and actually sort of collapsed, and hard to use for this purpose, which improved as it went from thick to thinner as it combined. The bottom line for me is if the whip was better quality and sturdier this alternative would be perfect for smaller batch mixing. I will keep this, but will be selective as to what I can use it for.
